class.name: FoundryScript
class.brief_description: A script implemented in the FoundryScript programming language.

method.name: get_type_parameter_list
method.description: Returns the generic type parameters declared directly on this script's class, in declaration order, as an array of [FSTypeParameter] descriptors. Returns an empty array for non-generic classes. This is part of the runtime reflection surface for FoundryScript generics. [codeblock] # class Box[T]: ... var Box = load("box.fs") for parameter in Box.get_type_parameter_list(): print(parameter.name) # Prints &"T" [/codeblock]

method.name: is_generic
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if this script's class declares one or more generic type parameters (for example [code]class Box[T][/code]). See [method get_type_parameter_list].

method.name: new
